text: Business Administration is a comprehensive discipline that studies organizational operations, resource management, and business decision-making. Its core objective is to cultivate business professionals with systematic management thinking, strategic vision, and practical capabilities, in order to address the challenges faced by various institutions such as enterprises and non-profit organizations during their operations. From team management of start-up companies to global strategic planning of multinational enterprises, from market expansion to financial management, Business Administration covers the entire process of business activities and serves as the "business universal language" that connects theory with practice.
